White Square Containing Black Small Square Symbol

There is no legacy Windows Alt code for White Square Containing Black Small Square because it is not in either the OEM code page 437 or Windows-1252 tables. The Unicode codepoint is U+25A3, which you can use as ▣ in HTML, \25A3 in CSS, or type with Alt+9635 on Windows (BMP only). If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, use the Character Viewer, the HTML entity, or copy the character directly. White Square Containing Black Small Square is outside both legacy code pages, which is why U+25A3 is the identifier that works across Word, HTML, CSS, Python and JavaScript. White Square Containing Black Small Square has no named HTML entity, so use the numeric escape ▣ or the hex escape ▣.

How to type white square containing black small square on Windows

  1. Turn Num Lock on so the numeric keypad is active.
  2. Hold the left Alt key.
  3. Type 9 6 3 5 on the numeric keypad for the decimal codepoint 9635.
  4. Release Alt. The White Square Containing Black Small Square character (▣) appears.

If your keyboard has no numeric keypad, see how to type symbols without a numpad.

How to type white square containing black small square on macOS

There is no direct Option shortcut for White Square Containing Black Small Square. Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space, search for "White Square Containing Black Small Square" and click the character to insert it.

How to use white square containing black small square in code

  • HTML: or
  • CSS: content:"\25A3"; ()
  • Python: \u25A3 or chr(0x25A3)
  • JavaScript: \u25A3 or String.fromCodePoint(0x25A3)
  • JSON: "\u25A3"

Frequently asked questions

Is there an Alt code for ▣?

No legacy Alt code exists for White Square Containing Black Small Square because it is not in code page 437 or Windows-1252. Use the Unicode codepoint U+25A3 in HTML, CSS or the Character Viewer instead.

How do I type ▣ without a numpad?

Use the Windows Character Viewer (Win+.), the macOS Character Viewer (⌃⌘Space), an HTML entity such as ▣, or copy the character directly from this page.

Why does Alt+9635 not work?

Alt+9635 only works on a keyboard with a physical numeric keypad. It also requires the application to accept the numeric-keypad input path. Laptops without a numpad need an alternative method.

What is the Unicode for White Square Containing Black Small Square?

The Unicode codepoint for White Square Containing Black Small Square is U+25A3. You can use this value in HTML as ▣, in CSS as \25A3, and in Word with Alt+X.

How do I type ▣ on a Mac?

Open the Character Viewer with ⌃⌘Space and search for the character name or U+25A3, then click it.
